Titles.jpn: 聖闘士星矢 セインティア翔

Summaries.eng: Shoko is a middle school student who goes to Ryusei Academy. Her older sister, who she was very close to, went to study overseas five years ago and hasn't been heard from since. One day, Shoko is attacked by a Dryad, a servant of the evil goddess Eris, who had been sealed away by the goddess Athena. Learning about Athena, Saints, and Saintias, as well as the cruel destiny that was thrust upon her sister and herself, Shoko decides to fight against fate.

Aliases: Knights of the Zodiac: Saintia Sho

Titles.eng: The Fated Sisters! Shoko and Kyoko
Titles.jpn: 宿命の姉妹！翔子と響子

Summaries.eng: Shoko is a student at Ryuusei Private Academy Middle School. Her dear sister, Kyoko, had went to study abroad five years ago and hasn't heard from her since. One day, an unknown entity suddenly attacks Shoko. The ones who attacked her had been the Dryads, underlings of the evil goddess, Eris, who was once sealed by goddess Athena. When Shoko and Saori Kido meet, the gears of destiny begin to turn!

Titles.eng: Individual Decisions! The Goddess and Saintias
Titles.jpn: それぞれの決意！女神と聖闘少女

Summaries.eng: Shoko cannot hide the shock knowing Kyoko was taken away instead of her as the evil god's host. As Shoko finds out the special position of Athena's handmaidens as well as bodyguards that only women can fill, she decides to become a Saintia herself from her desire to become stronger in order to rescue her sister. Saori requests the Silver Saint, Pavo Mayura, for Shoko's training, however…

Titles.eng: Blooming in Darkness! The Dryads of Eris
Titles.jpn: 闇に咲く！エリスの邪精霊たち

Summaries.eng: The underlings of the evil goddess, Malice Emony and Murder Phonos, plot to take Athena's head to offer it to Eris. Mii stands up against Emony, who continues to call Saori an "incomplete god". Shoko's Cosmo flares up during the training with Mayura. Sensing Athena is in danger, can Shoko ultimately save Saori?

Titles.eng: The Reunion of Sorrow! The Bond of the Separated Sisters
Titles.jpn: 哀しみの再会！隔たれた姉妹の絆

Summaries.eng: Shoko succeeded in entering Eris' temple by chasing Phonos who fled battle. As she searches the temple to save her sister, Kyoko, she is informed of a shocking fact by Ate. When Ate's vines catch Shoko off guard and begin to attack, a golden light enwraps her body! To bring back Shoko, Mii heads to Eris' temple.

Titles.jpn: 翔べ！ペガサスのように

Summaries.eng: Kyoko's Cosmo disappeared in the battle at Eris' temple. Saori's heart wavers as she questions her existence from not being able to save Kyoko in defeating the evil god. However, with Saori inheriting Mitsumasa Kido's will, the Galaxian Wars start without mercy. Shoko drops the pendant of Pegasus given to her by her sister. The boy who catches it for her is Pegasus Seiya, who is entering the Galaxian Wars.

Titles.eng: Colliding Souls! Saori vs. Grand Master
Titles.jpn: せめぎ合う魂！沙織vs.教皇

Summaries.eng: Pisces Aphrodite takes Athena to Sanctuary by order of the Grand Master, where they will meet face to face. What secret does the Grand Master hide behind his tears? Meanwhile, Mayura has detected that the remains of Eris are producing an effect that could be catastrophic.

Titles.eng: The Battle of the Twelve Palaces! The Allurement of the Terrifying Ghosts
Titles.jpn: 十二宮の死闘！恐るべき邪霊の幻惑

Summaries.eng: The moment the golden arrow strikes Saori, the Ghosts begin to stir. Shoko, who was the evil god's shell, loses consciousness, having her soul pulled by the Ghosts. Mayura and the Saintias work hard to calm the evil spirits while Seiya and the Bronze Saints hurry through Sanctuary to save Athena.

Titles.eng: A Clash of Nightmare! The Fists of Leo Flare Up
Titles.jpn: 悪夢の激突！燃えあがる獅子の拳

Summaries.eng: After the deadly battle, the Saints of Sanctuary all swear their loyalty to Saori—Athena. Meanwhile, Eris, who was thought to have been sealed, had fused with her host, Kyoko, and multiplied her powers. Saori rises against Eris to protect Shoko, but receives the curse of the apple. The Gold Saints head to the Temple of Eris along with the Saintias to save Athena and to stop the evil god from scattering the Evil Seeds of war that fill people's hearts with hate. That's where Aiolia witnesses his own brother turning his fists against him.

Titles.eng: A Spiral of Conflict! The Golden Apple and Orion's Devotion
Titles.jpn: 争いの渦！黄金の林檎とオリオンの献身

Summaries.eng: Can you defeat your sister who has fused with the evil god? With Mu's question, Shoko agonizes over the fate she bears. That's when Orion Rigel, the Ghost of an ex-Silver Saint, stands before Shoko. From Rigel's sad eyes that once shared a past with Kyoko during Saint years, Shoko senses his true feelings, and...

Titles.eng: Shine, Saintias! At the End of a Noble Prayer
Titles.jpn: 輝け少女たちよ！気高き祈りの果てに

Summaries.eng: Finally, Shoko faces the evil god Eris. As Saori's Cosmo grows weaker, all of the Saintias—Shoko, Mii, Xiaoling, Katja, and Erda—put their hearts together to challenge Eris. The Gold Saints continue to protect Sanctuary as they find out Eris' plan of crashing the temple into it. A raging destiny encircles the Saintias, Gold Saints, evil god Eris, and Saori Kido. The final battle begins.
